title: Hunts FH-036S: Wire the Experience Pass into ticket checkout and the organizer screen

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Call resolvePurchase from the Event ticket checkout for a bound tier (canonical price, snapshot stored with the ticket, return path from passReturnPath, huntSalesOpen checked before any session is created), add the organizer screen that writes a binding through validateBinding, and an admin toggle for the sales kill switch. Done when: through the real checkout a forged price, wrong tier and closed switch are refused, and the owner has a drill record of closing and reopening sales. Requires: FH-036, FH-040, FH-035. Owner role: Events and billing.

Built 2026-11-11 (part): lib/hunts/pass-gate.ts is called from createTicketCheckout for a bound tier behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED. It refuses a wrong tier or Event, a non-fixed-price tier, a retired binding, a sold-out tier and a closed kill switch with a buyer line that names no rule; an unbound or unreadable tier sells as before. The sales kill switch is a staff-only action and form on /hunts/finance (hunt_commerce_set_sales, audited). Still open: the organizer screen that writes a binding through validateBinding (it needs the benefit codes a published Hunt version offers, which no reader exposes yet), storing the purchase snapshot with the ticket, and the owner's drill record. The verify file lib/hunts/pass-checkout.ts is deliberately not created until those land.

Built 2026-11-11 (organizer screen): /hunts/edit/<id>/commerce (HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED, Hunt 'publish' gate) binds the Hunt's published version to a fixed-price ticket tier of its own Space through validateBinding and writes hunt_pass_bindings (lib/hunts/commerce-admin.ts bindPass). The benefit-code reader is lib/hunts/benefit-codes.ts: a version publishes codes as policy.benefits [{code,label}], and a version with none offers none, so a binding is refused by default. A person-owned Hunt has no seller Space and cannot sell. Still open: authoring policy.benefits in the Trail editor, storing the purchase snapshot with the ticket, and the owner's drill record of closing and reopening sales.

Built 2026-11-16 (closed for the engineering): (1) The Trail editor authors what a pass includes through the Hunt Studio entity (a `benefits` repeat of name and short code, shown only while HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED is on); the publish checklist refuses an incomplete or repeated code and the version publishes them as policy.benefits, the list a binding reads. (2) lib/hunts/pass-checkout.ts is what createTicketCheckout calls: beginPassCheckout resolves the purchase through the frozen binding before any Stripe session exists, and storePassPurchase writes the snapshot (binding, canonical price, quantity, amount charged) onto the reserved ticket in event_tickets.hunt_pass; a pass whose snapshot cannot be stored is not sold. Settlement reads it back (projectTicketBenefits) and projects only a ticket that carries a snapshot matching its settled row, under the binding it was bought under. Tested through the real checkout in lib/hunts/pass-checkout.test.ts: a forged price never reaches Stripe or the snapshot and a forged settled amount is refused, a wrong tier and a closed switch are refused before a session is created, an ordinary tier is untouched. Migration 20270346083000_hunt_pass_snapshot.sql (one nullable jsonb column, pgTAP in supabase/tests/hunt_pass_snapshot.test.sql) is NOT applied; the code is dark until it is and the switch is on. Not built here, and not claimed: the owner's drill record of closing and reopening sales is a human action and moved to FH-036T.
